name: HappyCo
description: HappyCo's MCP connects Claude to your maintenance operations data, so teams can ask natural-language questions and get real-time answers without switching tools. It supports analysis across properties, categories, and assignees, helping operations and portfolio teams spot trends and act faster, all backed by live data from HappyCo.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HappyCo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HappyCo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://happyco-mcp.happyco.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HappyCo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HappyCo provides these MCP tools: list_my_businesses and work_order_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HappyCo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HappyCo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
HappyCo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HappyCo is developed by HappyCo, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
